name: hud_ui_triplet_panel_unwind_destruct_first_item
description: HudUiTripletPanel::UnwindDestructFirstItem is the compiler-generated constructor-unwind helper that destroys items[0].
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. The retail body is compiler-generated EH unwind glue that adjusts this to items[0] and tail-jumps to HudUiWidget::DestructorCore.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40d600 adds 0x3c to ECX and tail-jumps to 0x4b3d50 HudUiWidget::DestructorCore.
0x4b3d50 HudUiWidget::DestructorCore is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_widget_destructor_core.
The native triplet-panel destructor smoke calls HudUiTripletPanel::UnwindDestructFirstItem directly and verifies only items[0] is destroyed while items[1] remains intact.
